Priya: putting final RN draft in the doc. Target deploy 2024-11-05 14:00 UTC. Need ops + comms signoff for cadence and rollback text. link: https://docs.internal/releases/infer-v2.6
Marco: reading now. Are we pinning inference:v2.6.0-canary for the first window?
Priya: yes, pin v2.6.0-canary for 8h at 5% traffic, then auto-promote to v2.6.0 if metrics pass.
Dee: propose rollback thresholds: >=4% 5xx sustained for 10m OR p95 latency >2s for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Include manual rollback if hallucination rate spikes on eval prompts.
Priya: agree. Assign rollback owner Hannah for first 8h. Hannah: I can take that shift. Rollback command I'll use:
```
infractl rollback --svc inference --to-tag v2.5.12 --reason "canary_failure"
```
Priya: paste that exact command into RN ops snippet and add runbook link. Also internal announce at T-10m in #eng-releases and #oncall; external announcement T+3h if canary successful. Add embargo flag.
Marco: microcopy for PMs: "No end-user changes; expect latency improvements on long responses ~6-9%". Good to include numbers.
deploybot: scheduled deploy 2024-11-05T14:00:00Z. Canary: 5% for 8h. Fallback: rollback to v2.5.12.
Dee: I'll update the doc with thresholds, owner, runbook link, telemetry tag rn-infer-v2.6 and paste final snippet in 12m.
Hannah: I'll be standing by during the window. If I trigger rollback I'll open incident channel and runpost-checklist.
Priya: thanks all 44d I'll send internal preflight at T-10m. Tagging this thread for RN archive.
